chunks: On the day that God will raise them together, they will swear before Him as they swear before you, and imagine they are on the right path. Is it not they who are liars?

key_terms.عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ: On something / on the right path

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when disbelievers swear oaths to God on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection, where they attempt to use their worldly rhetorical skills to deceive God, unaware that their self-deception is the ultimate falsehood. It underscores the concept of *ghurur* (deception) and the futility of human oaths when detached from divine truth, a theme often linked to the hypocrisy of the *Munafiqun*. The verse serves as a warning that mere verbal assertion without inner conviction leads to being counted among the liars despite their certainty.
